p.strong: Founded in 2009 by a practitioner who had seen what conventional executive search gets wrong, Zenith was designed from the start to serve organizations where leadership quality is a strategic variable; not a staffing question.

div.p: Most executive search firms are built for volume. They measure success in mandates filled and fees invoiced. Zenith was built around a different question: how many of the people we place are still in post and performing at 24 months?

Our answer: 97% is not an accident. It is the result of a methodology that treats each search as a unique problem, a partnership model that gives each client direct access to a senior partner throughout, and a candidate network assembled over 15 years of relationship-first outreach. We do not pitch. We work on mandates we believe we can win and we bring our full network and institutional knowledge to every one of them.
